headline: About 64 in 100 Malaysians aged 18 to 38 use TikTok regularly
why: Usage is higher among Malay audiences and in the Lower M40 income group.
idea: Short-form video stays the default format; brief creators by income and audience group.

headline: TikTok Shop outperforms traditional marketplaces in some lifestyle and beauty categories
why: Social commerce is moving sales off marketplaces in some categories.
idea: Build a TikTok Shop bundle for a Thai launch.

headline: Over 70% of Thai marketers report measurable ROI from influencer campaigns
why: Native-style creator content is beating polished brand ads.
idea: Move from one-off posts to longer creator partnerships.

headline: Singaporeans use 7.4 platforms a month and spend about 17 hours a week on social
why: Attention is split across many platforms, with WhatsApp leading monthly use.
idea: Plan across few platforms and go deep rather than spreading thin.

headline: TikTok leads daily engagement at 1 hour 39 minutes a day; YouTube leads session length
why: Video dominates attention, and social drives brand discovery.
idea: Lead with video on TikTok and use YouTube for longer stories.

headline: YouTube is the most-watched mobile app and reaches 80% of internet users
why: Video is the default place Australians spend time online.
idea: Plan YouTube as the anchor for longer creator stories.

headline: Six in ten Australians use social to research brands
why: Forums and community boards count as research, not only feeds.
idea: Seed honest product Q&A in community spaces.

headline: Social ads are the third most common source of brand discovery, after search and word of mouth
why: Social is a discovery channel, not only a retention channel.
idea: Measure reach and discovery, not only engagement.

why: Consumers are open to AI agents, but only 14% of brands have embedded agentic AI across the organisation.
idea: Keep an option to reach a human in every AI-led brand experience.

idea: Check data readiness before committing to AI-led campaigns.
